title: Joining a friend
summary: Connect to your friend's TAOM server.

sections.heading: Direct
steps: Type the host's address in Address. A 192.168 address only works on the same Wi Fi.
Type the port the host set. It is UDP 4200 unless the host changed it.
Type the password, or leave it empty when the server has none. Show lets you see it.
Pick the same mod setup as the host, then click Connect.
sections.tip: Check server tests if a server answers on that address. No reply does not always mean the server is stopped.

sections.heading: Steam lobby
steps: Steam has to run on both PCs. A Steam lobby needs no port forwarding.
Click Steam lobby and type the host's Steam profile name, the name friends see in Steam, not the login name.
Click Connect. The launcher looks for the lobby and starts the game.
sections.tip: The first start of a new TAOM campaign can take up to an hour, so the lobby can take that long to show up.

sections.heading: While it joins
steps: Connect turns green when the game is found, the mods are ready and the address or Steam name looks right.
The launcher starts Bannerlord and watches the Coop log. The activity log on the Logs and help page says Connected when the game joins.
When the server runs on this PC, the launcher fills in 127.0.0.1 for you.
The ? next to Steam lobby and Direct opens a short guide for each way to join.
